title: 'Cops everywhere': Wangchuk's wife Gitanjali claims he's under constant police vigil
content: Sonam Wangchuk, hours after he ended his 26-day hunger strike in the presence of Union ministers JP Nadda and Jitendra Singh, said he made the decision only after he got assurances from the govt and MPs across party lines that his demands for exam reforms and no action against peaceful protesters would be met.

title: 'Sack Pradhan from Cabinet': Rahul says ministerial reshuffle won't quell protest
content: "Students have three demands, and these are not negotiable demands... The first demand is that the Education Minister, who is corrupt, incompetent, and misaligned, has to be sacked... There's some talk going on in Modi's cabinet that the solution is to move Dharmendra Pradhan from education to some other ministry. This is not acceptable to the students of India. It is not acceptable to anybody," the Congress leader said.

title: Gambhir termed 'foolish' after ex-India selector's Sooryavanshi verdict
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi achieved a significant milestone by scoring a T20I half-century. He became the youngest player ever to reach this batting achievement. This performance followed his earlier inclusion and subsequent exclusion from the team. Former player Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticized the decision to drop him. Sooryavanshi's dedication and fearless approach were also highlighted.

title: Bill Gates once dragged his rival software boss to traffic court instead of a business meeting
content: Bill Gates once turned a business meeting with Microsoft rival Seymour Rubinstein into a trip to traffic court, where the WordStar founder coached the young co-founder on dodging jail and saving his license. From speeding Porsches and useless radar detectors to a sluggish diesel Mercedes he bought to slow himself down, here's how Gates's obsession with fast cars kept landing him in trouble.

title: Delhi: Cab driver found stabbed to death in car; passengers under suspicion
content: A 40-year-old cab driver was discovered stabbed inside his vehicle in Krishna Nagar. Police suspect passengers hired the car shortly before the fatal incident occurred. Vijay Kumar was found with multiple stab wounds while inside the driver's seat. His wallet and phone were present, suggesting robbery was not the motive. A PCR call reported the discovery around 9 PM on Thursday night.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' Day 3: Vijay's film adds Rs 1.94 Cr, India net hits Rs 65.79 Cr
content: Thalapathy Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' continues its strong theatrical run after a record opening.  The film has garnered over Rs 65 crore net in India within three days.  Worldwide gross collections for the movie have surpassed Rs 112 crore after two days.  Day two saw a decline in collections after its massive opening day performance.  Future weekend collections will determine the film's overall box office momentum.

title: NY mayor hires Lina Khan who went after Amazon, Meta and Google in her days as FTC head
content: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has roped in Lina Khan to lead the board of directors for the New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The former chair of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) known for her aggressive antitrust lawsuits against Big Tech. According to Business Insider, Mamdani called the duo a “dream team” and framed the appointments as a strategic effort to pair urban business growth with his progressive affordability agenda.

title: Chile community beats drought by restoring forests, soil and watershed
content: A rural community on Chile's Chiloe Island has restored its water supply after years of relying on emergency tanker trucks. By protecting forests, restoring its watershed, building a gravity-fed water network and involving local residents in maintenance, the community has maintained a reliable system for nearly seven years. The project is now being presented as a model for other rural areas facing water shortages.

title: Indian-origin man on green card says 'wouldn't move to US on H-1B today
content: Mohamed Zeeshan, an Indian-origin man who moved to the United States after being attracted to its 'values' has now said he 'wouldn't do it today' on an H-1B visa. Zeeshan, who now owns a consulting firm, said he is also seeing a rising trend of his relatives and friends looking at other options like Germany and Australia since it's become difficult to land a job and visa in the US after graduating.

title: After EU tariff relief, Trump threatens new tariffs over Google's $1Bn fine
content: President Donald Trump has threatened the European Union with new substantial tariffs. This action follows the EU's imposition of a one billion dollar fine on Google. The EU executive branch stated Google violated the Digital Markets Act rules. This fine was for self-preferencing its own services and steering consumers. The United States views these EU actions as detrimental to American companies.

title: CJP launches website, invites proof against ‘police excesses’
content: The Cockroach Janta Party launched a website for protest evidence.  They are collecting photos and videos of alleged police assaults.  The organization will identify officers and pursue legal action against them.  CJP also seeks a public apology from Delhi police and the Centre.  They demand assurances that protesters will not be targeted in the future.

title: Bengaluru horror: Man arrested for sexually assaulting cow
content: A 25-year-old man was arrested in Bengaluru for sexually assaulting a cow.  Nizamuddin, from Uttar Pradesh, was caught in the act by local residents.  He was also accused of indecent behavior towards a woman earlier.  Hindu organizations gathered, demanding strict legal action against the accused.  They called for maximum punishment under the law for this abhorrent act.

title: Army gets demo of indigenous counter-drone system 'Bhargavastra'
content: India has demonstrated Bhargavastra, a new counter-swarm drone system. This vehicle-mounted system integrates advanced sensors and a dual-layered kill mechanism. It combines micro-rockets and precision-guided micro-missiles for effective drone neutralization. Bhargavastra offers a cost-effective solution against autonomous drones and coordinated swarms. The system is designed for seamless integration with existing armed forces networks.

title: Argentina president breaks silence after 23 million sign petition demanding WC ban
content: Argentina's World Cup final controversy has escalated after the "Argentina Out" petition closed with more than 23.3 million verified signatures, narrowly missing a Guinness World Record. President Javier Milei hit back with defiant social media posts as FIFA continues investigating the post-match brawl, while a rival campaign demanding a replay of the final has also gathered widespread support.

title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash unveil Ramayana at Comic-Con, $40M campaign begins
content: The Ramayana film team unveiled its trailer at San Diego Comic-Con.  A significant international distribution partnership was also announced with Sony Pictures.  This collaboration aims to bring the epic story to global audiences.  The film is reportedly being made on a substantial budget.  Ramayana: Part One is currently targeting a Diwali 2026 release.

title: 'No question of retirement': BCCI rubbishes speculation over Rohit Sharma's future
content: BCCI vice-president Rajeev Shukla has dismissed rumors regarding Rohit Sharma's retirement. He stated there is no question of the Indian opener retiring at this stage. Sharma himself has expressed his desire to continue playing for India. He aims to secure a place in the 2027 ODI World Cup squad. Shukla also defended the current leadership group against calls for changes.

title: Delay in Dhanush procurement leaves Army short of modern guns
content: The Public Accounts Committee has criticized the Defence Ministry for procurement delays.  Significant gaps existed between Army needs and new artillery system inductions.  The Dhanush artillery gun, an upgraded Bofors, was inducted after a twenty-year gap.  Structural flaws in defence acquisition and a lack of expertise were highlighted.  The committee urged reforms to ensure timely acquisition and operational readiness.

title: 'Getting IV drips every morning': CJP's Abhijeet Dipke diagnosed with typhoid
content: Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of CJP, has publicly announced his fight against typhoid as he receives treatment. In his statement, he expressed sincere gratitude to the protesters who are uniting in peaceful assemblies nationwide. Dipke asserts that the ongoing demonstrations are crucial for pressing Dharmendra Pradhan to resign. Currently undergoing daily IV treatments, he attributes the movement's effectiveness to the passion and dedication of its supporters.

title: 'Even leftover food will taste like wedding meal': Ex-cricketer's take on India's win
content: Shreyas Iyer achieved his initial T20I captaincy victory against Zimbabwe.  The team secured a seven-wicket win in the opening match of the series.  This result provided significant relief for the captain after previous defeats.  Teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored a historic half-century in eighteen balls.  Sooryavanshi became the youngest player to achieve this international milestone.

title: 'Metro, roads, internet shut - but not paper leaks': Rahul attacks Centre
content: Rahul Gandhi criticized the Modi government's actions against students protesting the NEET paper leak.  He alleged the government imposed cruel restrictions to suppress the student movement.  Restrictions included shutting down metro, roads, internet, and food supplies.  Rahul compared the government's treatment of students to British tyranny.  He stated the government could not shut down paper leaks despite its actions.

title: Swept away 55km by raging river, elephant survives extraordinary flood ordeal in Assam
content: A 53-year-old elephant survived a 55-kilometer journey down a swollen river.  She was carried from Nagaland through turbulent floodwaters and rough terrain.  The animal finally washed ashore in Assam with an injured leg and exhaustion.  Veterinary teams are now providing round-the-clock medical care for the elephant.  This event highlights the immense power of the recent Assam-Nagaland border floods.

title: Maharashtra TET paper leak: Kingpin Bijendra Gupta arrested from Bihar
content: Maharashtra Police have arrested alleged TET paper leak mastermind Bijendra Gupta.  Gupta was apprehended in Bihar after evading law enforcement for months.  Another individual was also taken into custody during this significant operation.  His wife had previously been arrested in connection with the same paper leak case.  Gupta also faced scrutiny in 2024 following the NEET controversy.

title: 'Why is he always retained?': Ashwin fires back at Mayank Yadav's critics
content: Mayank Yadav made a strong comeback in his first international match since October 2024. He secured Player of the Match for his impressive bowling performance against Zimbabwe. This marked a significant return after a period of injury-related setbacks for the young bowler. Ravichandran Ashwin urged patience for players recovering from difficult physical and mental challenges. The team secured a convincing victory in the opening T20I match.

title: Kerala Plus Two SAY Result 2026 declared, scorecards available here
content: The Kerala Plus Two SAY and Improvement Examination Results 2026 have been declared on July 25, 2026, at 10:00 AM. Students can access their provisional scorecards through official result portals using their register number and date of birth. The examinations were conducted from June 29 to July 3, 2026, with around one lakh students participating. The SAY exams offered students an opportunity to clear pending subjects or improve marks after the March 2026 board examinations.

title: Nasa's puncture-proof tyre, built for Mars rovers, could replace rubber tyres
content: Nasa developed non-rubber, airless metal tyres using Nitinol. These puncture-proof tyres adapts to harsh terrain and extreme temperatures without damage, offering a smooth ride. Future applications may include heavy-duty trucks and commercial aircraft landing gear.

title: 20-yr-old army officer's son dies after car falls into open drain in south Delhi
content: Tragedy struck Vasant Kunj when a 20-year-old student named Yashvendra lost his life after his car rolled into an open drain. Having just returned from the United States, he was accompanied by a woman who managed to escape unharmed. Poor road conditions, exacerbated by recent rainfall, caused the car to skid. The police later retrieved both the vehicle and Yashvendra's body from the drain.

title: 'No talks unless Dharmendra Pradhan resigns': CJP warns of protest escalation
content: The Cockroach Janta Party continues its protest demanding Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation.  They received positive responses on compensation and legal cases during recent government meetings.  However, the group states no concrete decision has been made on their primary demand.  Activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his hunger strike after receiving written assurances from the Centre.  The CJP emphasizes accountability remains the movement's central and non-negotiable demand.

title: From selling vegetables to e-rickshaw driver: Bihar's Jhandu is now India's first CWG 2026 medallist
content: Bihar's Jhandu Kumar won India's first para powerlifting medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, claiming bronze in Glasgow after years of struggle. A former e-rickshaw driver who overcame financial hardship and polio, he lifted 190kg to reach the podium. "I feel as if I'm flying," Jhandu said, thanking his family, coaches, TOPS and SAI for their support.

title: 'That's the world we live in': Head breaks silence on wife's abuse after Kohli row
content: Travis Head dismissed rumours of a feud with Virat Kohli following their IPL 2026 handshake controversy, saying there was "nothing to patch over." The incident sparked online abuse directed at Head's wife, Jessica Davies, and affected their family. Head praised his wife for handling the situation with grace, adding that public scrutiny is part of professional sport.

title: Trump confirms Netanyahu's US visit next week amid regional tensions
content: Netanyahu and Trump agreed to meet in the United States a few weeks ago following a phone conversation. During the call, Netanyahu congratulated Trump on the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States and praised the close relationship between the two countries. ​​It comes as the US-Israeli war with Iran has again escalated following a breakdown earlier this month of a ceasefire reached as part of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed by the US and Iran.

title: CWG 2026: No ban on handshakes with Pakistan players, receiving gifts forbidden
content: Indian athletes will be free to decide for themselves whether to shake hands or exchange pleasantries with their Pakistani counterparts during the CWG . acceptance of gifts or presents from the neighbouring country’s athletes has been ruled out, TOI has learned .

title: 3 years on, SIT probe complete in just 10% of Manipur riot cases
content: the 3,000-odd cases have been probed by state police . the central probe agency has filed chargesheets in 21 cases and closure reports in six . it is continuing investigations into the remaining four cases . former Maharashtra DGP Dattatray Padsalgikar was appointed to oversee the investigations .

title: India's para cyclist Lisha Das rejects federation's support, opts for own kit and flag
content: minor para cyclist Lisha Das escalated her dispute with the country's sports authorities ahead of her departure for the Commonwealth Games . she said she would stay outside the team hotel, travel on independently booked tickets and decline the federation’s travel and accommodation arrangements in Glasgow . the athlete demanded immediate accreditation and field-of-play access for her coach, Aditya Mehta, saying the Delhi high court recognised him as her coach .
